title: eXoZymes Selects Curia as Commercial-Scale Manufacturing Partner for NCT
summary: Program expected to commence in Q4 2026 and establish a roadmap for larger-scale production in 2027 Los Angeles, CA -- September 8, 2026 -- Today, eXoZymes Inc. (NASDAQ: EXOZ) (“eXoZymes”) - a pioneer of AI-enhanced enzymes that transform abundant feedstock into valuable nutraceuticals and novel medicines - announced that it has entered into an agreement with Curia Global, Inc. (“Curia”), a global leader in contract manufacturing, to initiate technology transfer and scale-up activities for N-trans-caffeoyltyramine (“NCT”).
body_markdown:
- **Program expected to commence in Q4 2026 and establish a roadmap for larger-scale production in 2027**


**Los Angeles, CA -- September 8, 2026 -- Today, eXoZymes Inc. (NASDAQ: EXOZ) (“eXoZymes”) - a pioneer of AI-enhanced enzymes that transform abundant feedstock into valuable nutraceuticals and novel medicines - announced that it has entered into an agreement with Curia Global, Inc. (“Curia”), a global leader in contract manufacturing, to initiate technology transfer and scale-up activities for N-trans-caffeoyltyramine (“NCT”).**
